title: Recurrent headache
personality: Tired, speaks quietly, asks to dim the light
chief_complaint: Doctor, I keep getting terrible headaches, and today it's very bad again.
history_present_illness: Headaches started about two years ago, 2-3 times a month. Each attack lasts from several hours to a whole day if I do not take a pill. The pain is on one side, usually the right temple, throbbing, and gets worse when I walk or climb stairs. During attacks I feel sick, sometimes vomit, and light and noise are unbearable, I lie in a dark room. Before the headache there are no flashes or zigzags in the eyes. Attacks often come before my period, after a sleepless night or when I skip meals. Ibuprofen helped earlier, now it helps less.

symptoms.name: headache
symptoms.details: one-sided, usually right temple, throbbing, 8 out of 10; lasts 6-24 hours; 2-3 times a month for two years

symptoms.name: worse with activity
symptoms.details: walking and climbing stairs make it worse

symptoms.name: sensitivity to light and noise
symptoms.details: during attacks, needs a dark quiet room

symptoms.name: triggers
symptoms.details: before menstruation, lack of sleep, skipped meals

negative_symptoms: flashes or zigzag lines before the headache
weakness or numbness in arm or leg
headache that wakes her at night
past_medical_history: Healthy. No head injuries. No operations.
medications: Ibuprofen 400 mg during attacks, about 6-8 days a month. Combined oral contraceptive pill — no. No other medication.
family_history: Mother has had 'migraines' since her youth.
social_history: Works at the computer 9-10 hours a day, often sleeps 5-6 hours. Drinks 3-4 cups of coffee a day. Does not smoke, alcohol rarely.

test_results.General inspection: Pale, photophobic, prefers to keep eyes closed. No rash.
test_results.Neurological examination: Conscious, oriented. Cranial nerves intact, pupils equal and reactive. No papilloedema on fundoscopy. Strength 5/5 in all limbs, reflexes symmetric, no pathological reflexes. Coordination normal. No meningeal signs (neck supple, Kernig negative).
test_results.Head CT: No intracranial abnormalities (CT is not routinely indicated: no red flags).

test_reference_queries.Neurological examination: neurological examination to exclude secondary headache red flags
